custom_expected:
Step 2: Review action is visible and functional.
Step 5: Review action is no longer present on the WO.
custom_preconds: Test user role has Work orders View+Edit, View mode = Full View, Review work orders sub-toggle ON.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as test user. Open a WO that is in a state where Review is applicable.
  2. Look for a 'Review' action.
  3. As admin, edit the user's role and toggle Review work orders OFF. Save.
  4. Have the user log back in (forced logout) and reopen the same WO.
  5. Look for the Review action again.
title: Review work orders sub-toggle controls visibility of the Review action on WOs
